AI.conclusion: 快速冷却法可有效制备具有规则亚微米Nb析出物分布的Cu-Nb颗粒体系；该体系的超导耦合序参量受Nb颗粒构型调控，并呈现由Tc(H)和TcJ(H)所表征的双超导转变行为。

title: Learning Multiscale Dynamics of Nanoparticle Self-Assembly
summary: Nanoparticle self-assembly offers a powerful route to programmable functional materials, but its dynamics remain difficult to understand because they arise from multiscale, many-body, and environment-dependent interactions. Liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy (LPTEM) enables real-time observation of these dynamics, yet extracting the underlying physical laws from highly stochastic trajectories remains a significant challenge. Here we develop a physics-informed, time-varying autoregressive framework that learns multiscale self-assembly dynamics directly from LPTEM videos. Continuous Eulerian fields with local density and orientational order are coarse-grained from individual video frames and evolved by a sparse, nearest-neighbor operator optimized over a constrained matrix manifold. This interpretable approach captures long-time large scale phase transitions by tracking operator volatility over time, and short-timescale local evolution and transport rules. Crucially, we extract the underlying partial differential equations, where expected symmetries naturally emerge, enabling the direct inference of fundamental coefficients. Our framework provides a robust, computationally efficient tool for discovering hidden physical mechanisms from observational data, opening a path toward the predictive design of self-assembled nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种物理约束的时变自回归框架，从液相透射电镜视频中直接学习纳米颗粒多尺度自组装动力学，并提取能反映对称性的偏微分方程。
AI.motivation: 纳米颗粒自组装动力学由多尺度、多体、环境依赖的相互作用决定，难以理解；LPTEM虽能实时观测，但从高度随机的轨迹中提取物理规律仍很困难。
AI.method: 将视频帧粗粒化为含局部密度与取向序参量的连续欧拉场，用稀疏最近邻算子在受约束矩阵流形上优化来演化场；通过追踪算子随时间的波动捕获长时间大尺度相变，并提取含对称性的PDE以直接推断基本系数。
AI.result: 框架能捕捉长时间大尺度相变及短时局部演化与输运规则，并提取出呈现预期对称性的偏微分方程，从而推断基本物理系数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种稳健、计算高效的工具，可从观测数据中发现隐藏物理机制，为自组装纳米结构的预测性设计开辟道路。

title: Spin-Charge Conversion in an Epitaxial Kagome Flat-Band Metal
summary: The formation of topological flat bands near the Fermi level in kagome-structured metals has generated substantial research interest. One key consequence of this electronic structure is the strong anisotropy in charge transport, such as the significantly higher in-plane resistivity relative to the out-of-plane direction. However, the spin transport properties of these flat-band kagome metals are still largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate spin-charge conversion in CoSn, a representative flat-band kagome metal. Scanning tunneling microscopy is employed to image the CoSn surface with atomic resolution, and $dI/dV$ spectroscopy shows clear signatures of the flat bands. Using magneto-optical techniques, we quantify the spin-orbit torque (SOT) in bilayers of ferromagnetic nickel (Ni) and c-plane CoSn thin films. We find a large effective spin Hall angle of $θ_{SH} = 0.484 \pm 0.005$ within the CoSn layers, significantly exceeding the value measured for Pt of $θ_{SH} = 0.0436 \pm 0.0003$ in Ni/Pt bilayers. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations provide a microscopic understanding of the intrinsic spin Hall effect in CoSn, elucidating the sources of Berry curvature in momentum space. These findings establish kagome metals as promising materials for efficient spin-charge conversion and low-power spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平带kagome金属CoSn的自旋-电荷转换，测得CoSn层中巨大的有效自旋霍尔角θ_SH=0.484±0.005，远超Ni/Pt对照样品的0.0436，并结合DFT揭示其内禀自旋霍尔效应的Berry曲率来源。
AI.motivation: kagome金属中费米能级附近的拓扑平带引起电荷输运的强各向异性，但其自旋输运性质（尤其是自旋-电荷转换）尚未被充分探索，作者希望填补这一空白并评估其在自旋电子学中的潜力。
AI.method: 用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）对CoSn表面进行原子分辨成像，并通过dI/dV谱确认平带特征；采用磁光技术测量铁磁Ni/c面CoSn双层膜中的自旋轨道矩（SOT），提取有效自旋霍尔角，并与Ni/Pt双层对比；结合DFT计算分析动量空间中的Berry曲率来源，解释内禀自旋霍尔效应。
AI.result: STM成像获得原子分辨的CoSn表面，dI/dV谱显示清晰的平带信号；CoSn层中的有效自旋霍尔角为θ_SH=0.484±0.005，显著大于Ni/Pt中Pt的θ_SH=0.0436±0.0003；DFT计算给出了CoSn内禀自旋霍尔效应的微观图像并阐明Berry曲率来源。
AI.conclusion: 平带kagome金属CoSn具备高效的自旋-电荷转换能力，表明kagome金属是有前景的自旋电子学材料，可用于低功耗自旋电子器件。

title: Constructive Cavity Method for Ising Restricted and Deep Boltzmann Machines with Gaussian Couplings
summary: We apply the Constructive Cavity Method (CCM) to the dense, Ising type, restricted and deep Boltzmann machine with Gaussian couplings between adjacent layers. After identifying the core and interface contributions, CCM identifies the blanket decomposition of the cavity variables with the Aizenman--Sims--Starr random overlap structure. We apply the Random Energy Model (REM) universality ansatz to represent the cavity free energies by those of a generalized random energy model (GREM) and evaluate them recursively through Poisson point processes (PPPs). In the layer-wise gauge each layer is cut with its own cumulative fraction $|U_\ell\cap L_p|=λ_p q_\ell^{(p)}N+o(N)$, with $\mathbf 0=\mathbf q_0\le\mathbf q_1\le\cdots\le\mathbf q_r=\mathbf 1$, where $\mathbf q_\ell=(q_\ell^{(1)},\ldots,q_\ell^{(K)})$. Here $U_\ell$ is the cumulative blanket union up to blanket $\ell$. The index $p$ labels architectural layers, whereas $\ell$ labels the blankets. The dependence on the multilayer geometry is carried by the two matrices $M=2M_0Λ$ and $M_1=ΛM_0Λ$. The constructive cavity field in layer $p$ has blanket variances $Q_\ell^{(p)}-Q_{\ell-1}^{(p)}=(M(\mathbf q_\ell-\mathbf q_{\ell-1}))_p$, while the correction field has blanket variances $Q_\ell-Q_{\ell-1}=\mathbf q_\ell^\top M_1\mathbf q_\ell-\mathbf q_{\ell-1}^\top M_1\mathbf q_{\ell-1}$. The nested REM--PPP average gives the finite-level constructive cavity functional $\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{RBM/DBM}}^{\mathrm{CCM}}(ζ,\mathbf q)=\log2+\sum_{p=1}^Kλ_pX_0^{(p)}-\frac12\sum_{\ell=0}^{r-1}ζ_\ell(\mathbf q_{\ell+1}^\top M_1\mathbf q_{\ell+1}-\mathbf q_\ell^\top M_1\mathbf q_\ell)$. The balanced scalar gauge is recovered by imposing $\mathbf q_\ell=q_\ell\mathbf 1$. Selecting the physical value in the non-convex multilayer regime is a separate problem.

AI.tldr: 本文将构造空腔方法(CCM)推广到层间为高斯耦合的稠密Ising型限制/深度玻尔兹曼机,用Aizenman-Sims-Starr随机重叠结构与随机能量模型(GREM+泊松点过程)递推表示空腔自由能,给出多层几何(layer-wise gauge)下的有限层构造空腔泛函闭式。
AI.motivation: 稠密多层受限/深度玻尔兹曼机的自由能在有限层数、非凸区间缺乏严格可控的解析工具;希望将CCM这一从稀疏图成功的空腔工具推广到稠密多层架构,以获得可递归计算的自由能表达。
AI.method: (1) 对稠密Ising型RBM/DBM应用Constructive Cavity Method,区分core与interface贡献;(2) 将空腔变量的blanket分解与Aizenman-Sims-Starr(ASS)随机重叠结构对应;(3) 采用随机能量模型普适性假设,用广义随机能量模型(GREM)表示空腔自由能,并通过泊松点过程(PPP)递归求值;(4) 在分层规范中引入累积blanket比例q_ℓ,使每层被切割满足|U_ℓ∩L_p|=λ_p q_ℓ^(p)N+o(N);(5) 用两个依赖多层几何的矩阵M=2M_0Λ与M_1=ΛM_0Λ刻画空腔场与修正场的blanket方差;(6) 通过嵌套REM-PPP平均得到有限层构造空腔泛函P_CCM=RBM/DBM(ζ,q)的显式表达。
AI.result: 构造空腔场在第p层的blanket方差为Q_ℓ^(p)-Q_{ℓ-1}^(p)=(M(q_ℓ-q_{ℓ-1}))_p,修正场blanket方差为q_ℓ^⊤M_1q_ℓ-q_{ℓ-1}^⊤M_1q_{ℓ-1};有限层构造空腔泛函为 log2+Σ_p λ_p X_0^(p)-½Σ_{ℓ=0}^{r-1} ζ_ℓ(q_{ℓ+1}^⊤M_1q_{ℓ+1}-q_ℓ^⊤M_1q_ℓ)。均衡标量规范由q_ℓ=q_ℓ·1复原。非凸多层区间中物理值的选取仍为独立问题。
AI.conclusion: CCM与ASS重叠结构、GREM/PPP递归相容,可为稠密多层玻尔兹曼机提供结构清晰的有限层自由能泛函;但如何在非凸多层区域挑选物理解尚未解决,是后续工作。

title: Measurement-induced entanglement phases in hyperbolic gauge-Higgs models
summary: Gauge-Higgs theory in flat spacetime provides a prime theoretical model of multiple phases of matter with distinct entanglement structures. More recently, there has been interest in hyperbolic space and the influence its extensive boundaries have on these structures. Entanglement transitions between non-equilibrium phases, such as topological phases, can be realized by the competition of non-commutating measurements. Here we study the entanglement phases of gauge-Higgs models on hyperbolic lattices described by measurement-only dynamics. We chart 2D phase diagrams by employing topological entanglement entropy and introducing a generalized measurement-induced entanglement tailored for hyperbolic Higgs phases. Utilizing duality, we find a phase absent in Euclidean space, wherein the bulk lattice hosts separated clusters of symmetry-protected topological order. Transitions between this "archipelago" phase and neighboring topological and trivial phases feature a critical exponent $δ$ belonging to a mean-field universality class. Our essential tool is a 3D resource state inspired by measurement-based quantum computation that simulates the spacetime evolution of the 2D quantum state with a third direction of entanglement. This allows us to analyze spacetime "sponges" of entanglement, which map to classical percolation theory and allow us to infer values of critical points on our phase diagrams' boundaries.

AI.tldr: 该文研究双曲格点上规范-希格斯模型的测量诱导纠缠相变，发现欧氏空间所无的"群岛"相（体内分离的SPT序团簇），并借助3D资源态将时空纠缠映射为经典渗流从而确定相边界临界点。
AI.motivation: 规范-希格斯理论在平直时空可描述多种纠缠结构不同的物相；近期双曲空间及其广延边界对这些纠缠结构的影响受到关注，而测量非对易性可驱动非平衡拓扑相之间的纠缠相变，双曲格点上的这类相图尚未被刻画。
AI.method: 在双曲格点上构造仅含测量的动力学规范-希格斯模型，利用拓扑纠缠熵并引入针对双曲希格斯相的广义测量诱导纠缠，绘制2D相图；借对偶性分析相结构；核心工具是受测量基量子计算启发的3D资源态，以第三维纠缠模拟2D量子态的时空演化，将时空纠缠"海绵"映射为经典渗流。
AI.result: 发现欧氏空间中不存在的"群岛"相：体内晶格承载彼此分离的对称保护拓扑序团簇；该相与相邻拓扑相、平庸相的转变具有属于平均场普适类的临界指数δ；通过经典渗流推断出相图边界上的临界点数值。
AI.conclusion: 双曲几何的广延边界催生了新的纠缠物相与相变普适类；3D资源态与渗流映射为研究双曲测量诱导相变提供了有效且可推广的分析框架。

title: Laser-Induced 90-Degree Magnetization Switching for Single-Element 2D Sensing
summary: Magnetoresistive sensors with multiaxial sensitivity are interesting for field mapping applications where local measurement of multiple magnetic field components is needed. Existing device designs are often discretized with separate sensing elements for each vector component, or they require complex detection schemes to distinguish the different components. In this work, we showcase a single-element two-dimensional vector sensor with on-demand reprogrammable sensing axis using light and optically switchable materials. Our device is an anisotropic magnetoresistive sensor with $90^\circ$ togglable sensitivity upon excitation with ultrashort laser pulses. The sensor consists of an optically switchable Co/Gd thin-film bilayer, patterned into a cross shape that stabilizes two orthogonal in-plane magnetization directions. By selectively addressing one diagonal of the cross, a single laser pulses toggle switches the magnetization direction in the center of the cross by $90^\circ$. Moreover, the field sensitivity of the device is toggled between the $x$- and $y$-axes, which we detected electrically with the planar Hall effect. Our results form a milestone towards optically reprogrammable integrated magnetic vector sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种单元素二维磁矢量传感器，利用飞秒激光脉冲在Co/Gd双层膜十字结构中实现90°磁化翻转，从而按需切换x/y方向灵敏度，并通过平面霍尔效应电学读出。
AI.motivation: 现有多轴磁阻传感器通常需为每个矢量分量布置独立敏感元件（离散化），或依赖复杂的检测方案来区分不同分量，结构复杂、集成度低。作者希望实现单一元件即可测量多个磁场分量、且敏感轴可重构的矢量传感器。
AI.method: 器件为各向异性磁阻(AMR)传感器，材料为光可切换的Co/Gd薄膜双层，图形化为十字结构，稳定两个正交的面内磁化方向。通过选择性照射十字的一条对角线，用单个超短激光脉冲将十字中心磁化方向翻转90°，使磁场敏感方向在x轴与y轴之间切换；磁化状态与场灵敏度通过平面霍尔效应进行电学检测。
AI.result: 实验展示了单个激光脉冲即可实现十字中心磁化方向90°翻转，器件的场敏感轴随之在x轴与y轴间切换，并成功用电学方式（平面霍尔效应）检测到该切换，验证了单元素二维矢量传感与可重构敏感轴的功能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了光控可重构的集成磁矢量传感器，是迈向光学可编程集成磁矢量传感器的重要里程碑，为场映射等需要局部多分量测量的应用提供了简化、可重构的单元素方案。

title: First-principles-based search for emergent topological spin textures in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers
summary: Topological spin textures such as skyrmions and bimerons offer rich physical functionalities and strong potential for future spin-based technologies. Identifying materials that host such emergent magnetic states, however, remains challenging due to the complex interplay between microscopic magnetic interactions and large-scale spin textures. Here, using a multiscale first-principles discovery framework, we identify a broad class of two-dimensional materials that stabilize nontrivial spin textures. The framework integrates relativistic density functional theory, magnetic force theory, and atomistic spin-dynamics simulations, enabling a direct connection between electronic interactions and emergent magnetic textures and allowing efficient screening of systems with large magnetic unit cells and competing exchange interactions. Applying this approach, we systematically screen 312 monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides across 1T and 2H phases of 3d, 4d, and 5d transition metals. We uncover a diverse set of emergent spin textures, including skyrmions, bimerons, and complex domain states, and clarify their distinct stabilization mechanisms driven by exchange interactions, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, and magnetic frustration. These results identify promising candidate materials for topological spin textures and establish a transferable computational framework for accelerating materials discovery of complex magnetic states in two dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多尺度第一性原理发现框架，系统筛选312种单层过渡金属二硫属化物，识别出可稳定skyrmion、bimeron等拓扑自旋织构的二维材料并阐明其稳定机制。
AI.motivation: skyrmion、bimeron等拓扑自旋织构具有丰富物理功能与自旋技术应用潜力，但微观磁相互作用与大尺度自旋织构间耦合复杂，寻找能承载这类磁态的材料仍很困难，亟需高效的材料筛选手段。
AI.method: 构建多尺度第一性原理发现框架，整合相对论密度泛函理论、磁力理论（magnetic force theory）与原子尺度自旋动力学模拟，实现电子相互作用与涌现磁织构的直接关联，可高效筛选大磁原胞与竞争交换作用体系；据此系统扫描1T与2H相、3d/4d/5d过渡金属的312种单层TMD。
AI.result: 发现包含skyrmion、bimeron及复杂畴态的多样涌现自旋织构，并厘清由交换相互作用、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和磁阻挫驱动的不同稳定机制，给出有前景的候选材料清单。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出有潜力的拓扑自旋织构候选材料，并建立了可迁移的计算框架，可加速二维复杂磁态的材料发现。

title: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus
summary: Mobile anyons in topologically ordered phases provide a setting to investigate how fractional exchange statistics shapes collective behavior at finite density. We introduce AnyFormer: a neural variational framework for continuum anyons on a torus that explicitly incorporates statistical interactions and global winding constraints. We construct a smooth orbital frame that enforces the matrix-valued torus boundary conditions, and supplement it with an analytic pair factor that supplies the regular collision behavior. The orbital geometry and many-body amplitudes are optimized in parallel by variational Monte Carlo. We apply AnyFormer to semions without an external field or interaction potential, isolating unique correlations generated solely by statistics. Our framework closely matches exact two-semion energies and yields lower variational energies than finite-cutoff exact diagonalization for $N = 4$ and $6$ semions. Scaling up to $N = 16$ semions, well beyond the limits of continuum diagonalization, our calculations reveal states with pronounced correlation holes, suppressed long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a reversal of pair circulation at a distance set by the mean particle spacing. For $N = 12$ and $16$ semions, the circulation develops damped spatial oscillations. AnyFormer thus provides a scalable variational neural-net framework for microscopic studies of correlations, chiral motion, and collective phases of bulk anyonic matter.

AI.tldr: 提出AnyFormer——一个用于环面上连续任意子的神经变分蒙特卡洛框架，显式处理统计相互作用与环绕约束，并用其首次在大N下揭示半子(1/4统计)的关联洞、密度涨落抑制与配对环流反转等集体行为。
AI.motivation: 拓扑序中的可移动任意子为研究分数交换统计如何塑造有限密度下的集体行为提供了平台，但任意子的分数统计相互作用与环面全局环绕约束难以在连续空间变分方法中精确处理，导致大粒子数体系无法计算。
AI.method: 构造光滑"轨道框架"满足矩阵值的环面边界条件，并配合解析配对因子保证粒子碰撞时的正则行为；轨道几何与多体振幅由变分蒙特卡洛并行优化。在无外场、无相互作用势的条件下应用于半子体系，与精确二体解及有限截断精确对角化对比，并扩展到N=4,6,12,16。
AI.result: 二体能量与精确解吻合；N=4、6时变分能量低于有限截断精确对角化；扩展到N=16（远超连续区对角化极限）后，观察到显著的关联洞、长波密度涨落受抑，以及由平均粒子间距决定的配对环流反转；N=12、16时环流呈现阻尼空间振荡。
AI.conclusion: AnyFormer为块体任意子物质的关联、手性运动与集体相研究提供了可扩展的变分神经网框架。

title: Ferron-driven motion of non-collinear ferroelectric domain walls
summary: We study the propagation of ferrons, the quanta of electric polarization waves, through a ferroelectric texture. We predict by analytic and numerical calculations that a $90^\circ$ domain wall (DW) operates as a beam splitter of longitudinal ferron and transverse optical phonon modes. An associated momentum-flux imbalance leads to forces that drive DW motion. In the weak-anisotropy limit, the DW becomes a rotating texture with nearly fixed-modulus, whose low-energy dynamics is described by a sine-Gordon equation. A ferron source then attracts the DW through a damping-induced force. Both driving forces scale linearly with incident wave intensity. Our results uncover qualitatively different routes to driven ferroelectric DW motion enabled by the vector nature of the polarization and offer functionalities for THz ferroelectric devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究铁电体中铁振子（极化波量子）在铁电织构中的传播，预测90°畴壁可充当纵向铁振子与横向光学声子模式的"分束器"，并揭示其产生的动量流不平衡可驱动畴壁运动。
AI.motivation: 铁电畴壁通常被视为静态界面，而极化的矢量性质可能使波与畴壁相互作用产生新的驱动机制，本文旨在探索铁振子传播如何通过动量传递驱动畴壁运动。
AI.method: 采用解析与数值计算，分析铁振子在90°畴壁处的散射；计算动量流不平衡产生的力；在弱各向异性极限下用sine-Gordon方程描述畴壁的低能动力学，并考察阻尼诱导的吸引力。
AI.result: 90°畴壁表现为纵向铁振子与横向光学声子的分束器；动量流不平衡产生线性依赖于入射波强度的驱动力；弱各向异性极限下畴壁成为近固定模量的旋转织构，其低能动力学由sine-Gordon方程刻画；铁振子源通过阻尼诱导力吸引畴壁，两种驱动力均与入射波强度成线性关系。
AI.conclusion: 极化的矢量性质提供了性质不同的驱动铁电畴壁运动的新途径，并为THz铁电器件提供了潜在功能。

title: Comprehensive QM/ML Study of Dislocation Loop Line Segments in α-Zr Part I: <a> Loop Core Geometries, Solute Binding, and Transition Barriers
summary: Zr cladding alloys in nuclear reactors are exposed to high neutron fluxes, making irradiation-induced defects and solute segregation central to understanding their in-service behaviour. Dislocation cores involve short-range chemistry and long-range elastic fields, which are difficult to describe simultaneously using conventional atomistic methods. Using a hybrid quantum mechanics/machine learning (QM/ML) framework, this part of work examines prismatic <a> loops in hcp α-Zr. All three loop variants are considered, including faulted and perfect, interstitial- and vacancy-type, and first- and second-order prismatic configurations. Nine possible dislocation line segments are characterised in terms of core geometry, solute binding, glide barriers and faulted-to-perfect transition pathways using QM/ML and newly implemented QM/ML-NEB calculations. Shockley and half-Shockley partials, together with basal and prismatic fault ribbons, are found to govern core stabilisation. Fe and H preferentially bind to faulted segments, whereas Sn and Nb favour perfect segments. Solutes can also drive partial motion, recombination and local unfaulting. These results establish a comprehensive picture of <a> loop microstructure, solute trapping and transition mechanisms in α-Zr.

AI.tldr: 本文用混合QM/ML框架研究hcp α-Zr中棱柱<a>位错环的全部构型与9种位错线段的核心结构、溶质结合、滑移势垒及层错-完美转变路径。
AI.motivation: Zr包壳合金在高中子通量下产生辐照缺陷与溶质偏聚，而位错核心同时涉及短程化学与长程弹性场，传统原子尺度方法难以兼顾，需更精确的多尺度方法刻画<a>环的微观结构与溶质行为。
AI.method: 采用量子力学/机器学习(QM/ML)混合框架，涵盖层错与完美、间隙型与空位型、一阶与二阶棱柱环构型；对9种位错线段分析核心几何、溶质结合能、滑移势垒，并新实现QM/ML-NEB计算层错向完美的转变路径。
AI.result: 发现Shockley与半Shockley分位错及基面、棱柱层错带支配核心稳定性；Fe、H倾向结合层错段，Sn、Nb倾向结合完美段；溶质可驱动分位错运动、复合与局部去层错化。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了α-Zr中<a>环微观结构、溶质捕获与转变机制的完整图像，为辐照条件下Zr合金行为预测提供基础。

title: Designing Geared Molecular Rotors in Flexible Metal-Organic Frameworks
summary: Translating macroscopic mechanical concepts such as gears to the molecular scale offers a route to precise control over nanoscale motion, inspired by the efficiency of biological machines. In this work, we explore two-dimensional interlocked linker rotations in the flexible metal-organic framework NU-2002. The volume-dependent free energy landscape is mapped using bias-deletion metadynamics to identify six characteristic phases, ranging from very closed to very open pore. We then perform unbiased molecular dynamics simulations at each phase to track rotation events and evaluate co-rotation statistics, calculate free energy barriers, and measure pairwise radial force transfer between neighbouring linkers. We show that the free energy barrier acts as a rotational-speed filter, where rare rotational transitions lead to higher speeds on average. Across the volume profile, we classify four distinct geared regimes: sterically restricted rotations at small volumes (Jammed Gear), rotational coupling extending to third neighbour linkers (First Gear), in-plane partnered linker coupling (Second Gear), and uncoupled, independent rotation at large volumes (Neutral Gear). Together, these results establish framework breathing as a molecular gearbox that switches both the speed and collective coupling of linker rotation. Framework flexibility therefore offers a handle for programming collective motion in solid-state molecular machines.

AI.tldr: 本文在柔性MOF材料NU-2002中研究二维互锁配体的旋转，用偏置删除元动力学映射自由能景观并识别六个孔道相态，进而通过无偏MD揭示自由能势垒作为"转速过滤器"、并随体积呈现四种"齿轮"耦合模式。
AI.motivation: 将齿轮等宏观机械概念引入分子尺度，可为纳米尺度运动的精确控制提供途径，借鉴生物机器的高效性。本文希望探究柔性金属有机框架中互锁配体的旋转能否实现类似的齿轮式耦合与调控。
AI.method: 在柔性MOF NU-2002中研究二维互锁配体旋转；用偏置删除元动力学（bias-deletion metadynamics）绘制体积依赖的自由能景观，识别六个特征相态（从极闭合到极开放孔）；在每个相态下进行无偏分子动力学模拟，追踪旋转事件、统计共旋转、计算自由能势垒、测量相邻配体间成对径向力传递。
AI.result: 自由能势垒充当"转速过滤器"——稀少的旋转跃迁平均对应更高转速。随体积变化可划分四种齿轮状态：小体积下受位阻限制的Jammed Gear；旋转耦合延伸至第三近邻的First Gear；面内成对配体耦合的Second Gear；大体积下无耦合独立旋转的Neutral Gear。
AI.conclusion: 框架"呼吸"效应构成一个分子齿轮箱，可同时切换配体旋转的转速与集体耦合方式；框架柔性因此为固态分子机器中集体运动的编程提供了调控手段。

title: Where Does the Anion-Redox Hole Go? Reliability of Open-Shell Projection-Based Embedding for Li-Rich Cathodes, from DFT Environments to Quantum Solvers
summary: Anion redox in Li-rich layered oxides places holes on oxygen next to an antiferromagnetic Mn(IV) d3 lattice, a strongly correlated open-shell problem for which projection-based wavefunction-in-DFT embedding offers a route to correlated and quantum solvers, but whose errors are known mainly for closed-shell molecules. We develop a spin-unrestricted projection-based embedding, exact at the DFT-in-DFT level to the microhartree scale for closed-shell, broken-symmetry and high-spin references with point charges, and apply DMRG-in-DFT to point-charge clusters of delithiated Li(2-x)MnO3, varying the environment functional (0-100% exact exchange), geometry, active region, active-space spin, virtual space, cluster size and magnetic reference. In every setting the lowest SCF state places the hole on an oxygen pair, with no O-O bond. How the hole is shared depends on the functional together with the geometry: hybrids give a full, uncoupled hole at the DFT+U geometry but a partial, weakly covalent hole at their own geometry, a change of up to 0.5 e on one oxygen. Where spin spreads across the active/environment boundary, the integer spin projection of the active space becomes a choice worth up to 0.26 e, and at most 0.09 e once the two Mn neighbors are included. An extended state search found missed lower states for two functionals, changing a pair-oxygen spin by up to 0.45 e. Across all 82 runs the embedded mean field gives the same hole (median DMRG change 0.02-0.04 e); correlation mainly adds O-O covalency. State control and geometry consistency, not the solver, dominate the uncertainty, and total energies are not converged at 30-40 orbitals. For quantum solvers, the embedded Hamiltonian must be spin-unrestricted: a shared-orbital form reverses the hole, while sample-based quantum diagonalization reproduces exact diagonalization, as accurately as, but not better than, classical selected CI.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了自旋非限制投影嵌入方法，并将DMRG-DFT应用于脱锂Li(2-x)MnO3点电荷团簇，系统考察环境泛函、几何、活性区、自旋投影等对氧空穴分布的影响。结果表明嵌入平均场基本决定空穴位置，关联主要增加O-O共价性；状态控制与几何一致性而非求解器主导不确定性，量子求解器需自旋非限制Hamiltonian。
AI.motivation: 富锂层状氧化物中的阴离子氧化还原把空穴置于反铁磁Mn(IV) d3晶格旁的氧上，是强关联开壳层问题；投影嵌入为关联/量子求解器提供途径，但其误差主要在闭壳层分子中被了解，开壳层磁性体系缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 发展自旋非限制的投影基wavefunction-in-DFT嵌入（DFT-in-DFT层面达微hartree精度，适用闭壳层、破对称与高自旋参考及点电荷）；对脱锂Li(2-x)MnO3点电荷团簇应用DMRG-in-DFT，扫描环境泛函（0–100% exact exchange）、几何、活性区、活性空间自旋、虚空间、团簇尺寸与磁参考等，并开展扩展态搜索与量子求解器对比。
AI.result: 所有设定下最低SCF态都将空穴放在氧对上且无O-O键。空穴共享方式取决于泛函与几何：杂化泛函在DFT+U几何给出完整未耦合空穴，在自身几何给出部分弱共价空穴，单氧上变化达0.5 e。跨界自旋扩散使整数自旋投影成为最高0.26 e的选择，纳入两个Mn近邻后降至0.09 e。扩展态搜索在两个泛函下发现遗漏的低能态，改变对氧自旋达0.45 e。82次运行中嵌入平均场给出一致空穴（DMRG中位变化0.02–0.04 e），关联主要增加O-O共价性。共享轨道形式会反转空穴；基于采样的量子对角化可媲美经典selected CI，但不更优。
AI.conclusion: 状态控制与几何一致性而非求解器主导不确定度，30–40轨道下总能量未收敛。对量子求解器而言嵌入Hamiltonian必须自旋非限制；量子求解器精度可匹敌但不优于经典selected CI。

title: Robustness of Anyonic Time-Domain Interference Against Dephasing
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material: 16 pages, 1 figure
summary: Recent anyon-collider experiments have identified time-domain braiding (TDB) as a new route to probing anyonic statistics. However, how such time-domain interference responds to environmental noise remains an open question. Here we show that TDB interference is intrinsically more robust than its spatial counterpart. In conventional spatial interference, environmental noise induces phase fluctuations that accumulate throughout all paths, leading to exponential suppression of the interference as the dephasing rate increases. In TDB, by contrast, the interfering temporal paths experience largely overlapping environmental fluctuations, whose contributions cancel out in the relative phase, so that only a small nonoverlapping temporal window contributes to dephasing. As a result, TDB interference decays only algebraically with the dephasing rate, providing a new experimental hallmark for its identification. We propose a Fabry-Perot fractional quantum Hall setup in which both types of interference coexist and experience the same environmental noise, enabling a direct comparison of their dephasing behaviors. Our results establish robustness against dephasing as a fundamental advantage of TDB and suggest new opportunities for exploiting anyonic interference in noisy mesoscopic systems.

AI.tldr: 时间域编织(TDB)干涉对环境退相位本质性优于空间干涉：其退相干只依赖非重叠时间窗口，随退相位率代数衰减而非指数衰减，可作为TDB的实验判据。
AI.motivation: TDB已被视为探测任意子统计的新途径，但其时间域干涉对环境噪声的响应尚不清楚，本文旨在弄清TDB退相干行为并寻找其识别特征。
AI.method: 对比分析空间干涉与TDB中环境相位涨落的累积方式：空间干涉各路径全程涨落不相关，而TDB的交叠时间路径共享大部分涨落、在相对相位中抵消；并提出在同一噪声下两种干涉共存的Fabry-Perot分数量子霍尔装置，用于直接比较。
AI.result: 空间干涉随退相位率指数抑制；TDB干涉仅代数（幂律）衰减，源于仅非重叠时间窗口贡献退相位，且两种干涉可在同一装置中受相同噪声直接对比。
AI.conclusion: 抗退相位鲁棒性是TDB的基本优势，代数衰减为TDB提供新的实验标志，并利于在噪声介观系统中利用任意子干涉。

title: Fracture Mechanics and Self-Healing in Molecular Crystal Resonators for Lasing
summary: Microscale damage poses a significant challenge to the reliability and longevity of miniaturized photonic devices; however, the mechanisms and repair of microscopic cracks and fractures in organic optical crystals remain largely unexplored. Here, we employ a mechanophotonic approach to induce microscale cracks and complete fractures in single crystals of 3-[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-1-(2-hydroxyphenyl)prop-2-en-1-one (HDMAC) using an atomic force microscopy (AFM) cantilever tip. We demonstrate the self-healing capability of these crystals while retaining their optical waveguiding and resonator properties, which are essential for lasing applications. HDMAC microcrystals exhibit self-healing of cracks introduced along the (010) and (001) crystallographic planes, demonstrating the versatility of this phenomenon across distinct crystal orientations. Furthermore, we identify different fracture mechanisms and establish a comprehensive assessment of healing efficiency by integrating optical loss measurements, resonator characteristics, and nanomechanical analyses. This multifaceted approach enables fair evaluation of the recovery of structural integrity and photonic functionality following self-healing.

AI.tldr: 该研究用品格AFM探针在有机光学晶体HDMAC上引入微裂纹与断裂，证明其可自愈合，并保持光波导与谐振（激光）性能。
AI.motivation: 微型光子器件的可靠性与寿命受微尺度损伤严重制约，而有机光学晶体中微裂纹/断裂的机制与修复几乎未被研究。
AI.method: 采用"机械光子学"方法，用AFM悬臂针尖在HDMAC单晶上诱导沿(010)与(001)晶面的微裂纹及完全断裂；结合光损耗测量、谐振腔特性与纳米力学分析综合评估愈合效率。
AI.result: HDMAC微晶可对沿不同晶面引入的裂纹实现自愈合，并恢复光波导与谐振（激光）功能；识别出不同断裂机制，建立了多维度愈合效率评估体系。
AI.conclusion: 有机光学晶体具备跨晶向的自愈合能力，可在修复后保持结构完整性与光子功能，为微型光子器件的损伤修复提供新思路。

title: Ground-State Properties of a Lattice-Coupled Strongly Correlated Model for Solid Oxygen under Pressure
summary:
Solid oxygen is an $S=1$ molecular magnet with strong
  coupling between spin and lattice degrees of freedom.
  Recent studies suggest that magnetic moments
  coexist with tetramer distortions under pressure.
  We derive an effective spin Hamiltonian from a two-orbital
  Peierls--Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling.
  The resulting model contains competing easy-plane
  single-ion and easy-axis exchange anisotropies.
  We analyze this model on a square lattice using quantum Monte Carlo simulations
  and evaluate the magnetic contribution to the lattice stiffness
  for several lattice distortion patterns including the tetramer pattern.
  We find that the tetramer pattern is the most favorable
  among the considered distortion patterns throughout the parameter range studied.
  Moreover, competition between the two anisotropies
  enhances the tendency toward lattice distortion
  and strengthens the preference for tetramerization over the other patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文从含自旋轨道耦合的双轨道Peierls–Hubbard模型导出有效自旋哈密顿量，并用量子蒙特卡罗研究固体氧中磁性与四方（tetramer）晶格畸变的耦合，发现四方畸变在参数范围内最有利，且各向异性竞争增强晶格畸变倾向。
AI.motivation: 固体氧是S=1分子磁体，自旋与晶格自由度强耦合；近期研究提示压力下磁矩与tetramer畸变共存，但缺乏统一的有效模型来解释磁性如何驱动并偏好特定畸变模式。
AI.method: 从含自旋轨道耦合的双轨道Peierls–Hubbard模型出发，推导有效自旋哈密顿量，其包含相互竞争的面内易轴（easy-plane）单离子各向异性与易轴（easy-axis）交换各向异性；在方晶格上用量子蒙特卡罗模拟，计算多种晶格畸变模式（含tetramer模式）下的磁对晶格刚度（lattice stiffness）的贡献。
AI.result: 在所研究的整个参数范围内，tetramer畸变模式在考虑的畸变模式中最有利；两种各向异性的竞争增强晶格畸变倾向，并强化四方化相对其他模式的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 磁各向异性竞争可作为固体氧中tetramer化的驱动机制，为理解压力下磁性与晶格畸变共存提供理论支持。

title: In-situ Control of the Photon-Magnon Synchronized Mode in a Miniaturized Magnetometer
summary: Photon-magnon synchronized modes (PMSMs) provide a route for magnetic-field sensing by exploiting their enhanced field responsivity due to cusp points (CPs). However, the previous PMSM magnetometer relies on bulky discrete components and lacks in situ control of photon-magnon interactions, limiting its integration and adaptability. Here, we demonstrate a miniaturized PMSM magnetometer integrated on a printed circuit board. A variable resistor is used to tune the photon-magnon coupling strength in situ. By adjusting the variable resistor, the electromagnetic boundary condition of the magnetometer is altered; hence, the reservoir-mediated photon-magnon interaction is changed. The coupling strength shows a non-monotonic dependence on the reflection coefficient adjusted by the variable resistor and reaches its minimum at the impedance matching condition. Furthermore, we develop a non-Hermitian model with standing-wave interference to describe the PMSM dispersion and derive the critical condition for CP formation. This work realizes a compact and tunable PMSM magnetometer and provides a pathway for controlling photon-magnon interactions in integrated magnetic sensing systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种集成于印刷电路板的小型化光子-磁振子同步模式(PMSM)磁力计，用可变电阻原位调节光子-磁振子耦合强度，并建立含驻波干涉的非厄米模型解释色散与尖点(CP)形成条件。
AI.motivation: 以往PMSM磁力计依赖笨重的分立元件，且缺乏对光子-磁振子相互作用的原位调控手段，限制了集成度与适应性。本文旨在实现紧凑、可调谐的PMSM磁力计。
AI.method: 将PMSM结构集成在PCB上；通过可变电阻改变电磁边界条件，从而调控由环境(库)介导的光子-磁振子耦合强度；建立含驻波干涉的非厄米模型，描述PMSM色散关系并推导CP形成的临界条件。
AI.result: 耦合强度随可变电阻调节的反射系数呈非单调依赖，并在阻抗匹配条件下达到最小值；模型成功描述了PMSM色散与CP形成条件。
AI.conclusion: 实现了紧凑、可调谐的PMSM磁力计，为集成磁传感系统中光子-磁振子相互作用的调控提供了途径。

title: Magnon Super-Bloch Oscillations and Switchable Transport in Driven Magnonic Crystals
summary: Super-Bloch oscillations (SBOs) offer a powerful route to control wave packet propagation in driven lattices, yet their realization in magnonic systems has remained elusive. Here, we predict SBOs of magnon wave packets in periodic magnonic crystals driven by static and ac gradients of magnetic anisotropy field. A static gradient alone induces magnon Bloch oscillation (BO) with a constant carrier frequency. Remarkably, adding a near-resonant MHz-scale ac driving gives rise to a slow large-amplitude envelope oscillation, the hallmark of SBO. At exact resonance, the ac driving enables phase-controlled directional transport with a carrier-frequency shift up to GHz scale. Consequently, the same structure can be switched among three distinct regimes: conventional BO, SBO, and directed transport. Analytical expressions for the oscillation amplitudes, superperiod, drift velocity, and frequency evolution are validated by micromagnetic simulations. Extending to antiferromagnet magnonic crystals, we further demonstrate that these effects drive opposite motions of two oppositely polarized magnon modes in THz range. Our work establishes magnon SBOs as a versatile platform, opening a new avenue for reconfigurable magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文预测在静磁各向异性场梯度与近共振MHz交变驱动共同作用下的磁振子晶体中可实现超布洛赫振荡（SBO），并可通过驱动条件在常规布洛赫振荡、SBO与定向输运三种模式间切换。
AI.motivation: SBO是控制驱动晶格中波包传播的有力手段，但其在磁振子系统中的实现一直缺失，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在周期磁振子晶体中同时施加静态与交变磁各向异性场梯度；仅静态梯度产生恒定载频的布洛赫振荡，叠加近共振MHz交变驱动则产生慢速大幅包络振荡（即SBO）；解析推导振荡振幅、超周期、漂移速度与频率演化，并用微磁学模拟验证，进而推广到反铁磁磁振子晶体。
AI.result: 解析表达式与微磁学模拟一致；精确共振时交变驱动可实现相位可控的定向输运，载频移动达GHz量级；同一结构可切换于BO、SBO和定向输运三种状态；在反铁磁晶体中，两种相反偏振磁振子模式在THz范围沿相反方向运动。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了磁振子SBO作为通用平台，为可重构磁振子器件开辟了新途径。

title: Algebraic flat bands and even central-band Chern numbers in a seven-orbital hopping model
summary: Turning a flat-band parent into an isolated Chern band requires supervise of destructive interference, hopping phases, and the cell translations of the bonds. We study this connection in a seven-orbital 2 times 2 supercell honeycomb-vacancy lattice, combining analytic reductions with Bloch spectra, lattice Chern invariants, and quantum geometry. The parent lattice has three exact flat branches, a smooth periodic zero mode, and a compact localized state. A uniform gap bound shows that faint intracell-loop hopping preserves two topologically trivial insulating gaps. The intracell hopping graph also admits a staggered chiral coloring: reversing site amplitudes according to this coloring links opposite energies at momenta separated by half a reciprocal period. This constraint restricts the isolated central band to even Chern numbers and forbids a zero-energy insulating filling at every loop phase. Purely imaginary loop hopping admits a real gauge, whereas other phases allow paired band contacts connecting central bands with C3=2 and C3=4. On a specified strong-loop cut, third-order masses open the direct gaps; these gaps shrink faster than the bandwidth as the coupling grows. Changing the bond connectivity to an oriented honeycomb next-nearest-neighbor extension generates a narrower Chern band with nonuniform quantum geometry. These results distinguish individual-band topology from occupied-group topology and reveal how bond connectivity and cell translations determine which topological bands can emerge from an exactly flat parent.

AI.tldr: 本文在七轨道2×2超胞蜂窝-空位晶格中研究如何将精确平带母体调控为孤立陈带，揭示键连通性与元胞平移如何决定可涌现的拓扑带。
AI.motivation: 平带母体本身拓扑平凡，要得到孤立陈带需要"破坏性干涉、跃迁相位与键的元胞平移"三者协同；作者想厘清这一关联，并区分单带拓扑与占据群拓扑。
AI.method: 解析约化结合Bloch谱、晶格陈不变量与量子几何。构造七轨道2×2超胞蜂窝-空位晶格；用均匀能隙界、交错手征着色（按着色翻转格点振幅）论证中心带陈数只能为偶数；考察环内纯虚跃迁（可实规范）与其他相位下的成对带接触；并在指定强环截断处加三阶质量打开能隙；再将键连通性改为取向蜂窝次近邻扩展。
AI.result: 母体有三个精确平带、一个光滑周期零模和一个紧局域态；微弱的胞内环跃迁仍保留两个拓扑平凡绝缘能隙；交错手征着色使中心带限于偶数陈数，并禁止任一环相下的零能绝缘填充；纯虚环跃迁允许实规范，其他相位给出连接C3=2与C3=4中心带的成对带接触；强环截断处三阶质量打开直接能隙，但能隙随耦合增大比带宽收缩更快；取向蜂窝次近邻扩展得到更窄的陈带，量子几何非均匀。
AI.conclusion: 键连通性与元胞平移决定了从精确平带母体可涌现哪些拓扑带；研究区分了单带拓扑与占据群拓扑。混合解析-数值框架为平带陈绝缘体设计提供依据与约束。

title: Spatial localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts in substitutional Mn-doped Ge: A first-principles study
comment: Submitted to Physica B: Condensed Matter. Includes Supplementary Information
summary: Magnetic energy gaps do not reveal the spatial distribution of magnetic-state-dependent atomic forces. We compare ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic forces at identical nuclear positions in 64-site substitutional Mn-doped Ge using collinear PBE calculations. For nearest-neighbour Mn pairs, the radial force projection reverses sign between magnetic branches. In the second-neighbour geometry, the shared Ge neighbour has the largest force contrast, about 2.2 times that of equally near Ge sites coordinated to one Mn. Bridge-displacement gap slopes agree with direct force derivatives across four numerical settings. Tightening the electronic threshold by 100-fold preserves magnetic ordering and the leading site, while the force-contrast vector changes by 1.08% despite a nearly unchanged energy gap. The results identify coordination-associated localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts within the frozen model, without establishing relaxed distortions, full numerical convergence or a unique exchange mechanism.

AI.tldr: 用64原子Mn掺杂Ge的共线PBE计算表明，磁能隙不反映磁态依赖原子力的空间分布；力对比主要集中在共享配位位点，而非由能隙指示。
AI.motivation: 通常以磁能隙刻画磁耦合，但能隙是标量，无法揭示磁态依赖的原子力在空间上的分布。作者希望检验铁磁与反铁磁分支的力差异是否局域于特定配位环境。
AI.method: 在相同核位置下比较铁磁与反铁磁的原子力，采用64位点替位Mn掺杂Ge的共线PBE计算；考察最近邻与次近邻Mn对，比较径向力投影、力对比大小，并用桥位移-能隙斜率与直接力导数在四种数值设置下交叉验证。
AI.result: 最近邻Mn对的径向力投影在两磁分支间反号；次近邻构型中共享Ge邻居力对比最大，约为仅配位一个Mn的等距Ge位点的2.2倍；桥位移能隙斜率与直接力导数在四种设置下一致；电子阈值收紧100倍后磁序与主导位点不变，能隙几乎不变而力对比矢量仅变1.08%。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结模型内，磁分支力对比与配位局域化相关，但不能据此认定弛豫畸变、完全数值收敛或唯一交换机制。

title: Antisymmetric thermopower without magnetism in three-phase composites
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 4 Extended Data figures; Supplementary Information (43 pages) included. Code and data: https://github.com/joohan-git/antisymmetric-thermopower (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23668925)
summary: A thermopower that turns a temperature gradient into a perpendicular electric field in every in-plane direction has relied on magnetism. Reciprocity permits it without magnetism, yet under a three-fold or higher axis it vanishes both in reciprocal elastic band transport and in composites of two isotropic phases with ideal interfaces. Here we show that composites of three isotropic phases carry it, and that under such an axis three is the minimum. A third, linearly independent transport matrix escapes the exact two-phase reduction; at weak contrast the first allowed axial term is cubic, proportional to a determinant of the three matrices times material-weighted, handed three-point correlations. Treating the phases as colours identifies the arrangements that allow the response, and crystal nets from reticular chemistry supply printable three-dimensional ones. Certified two-sided bounds give axial Seebeck coefficients of 49.5-50.2 $μ$V K$^{-1}$ in a planar cell and 76-84 $μ$V K$^{-1}$ in a printable woodpile; reflections in planes containing the axis reverse the response, and recolouring 24 nets to restore their parent symmetry switches it off. Around a line heat source the axial driving field has the $1/r$ azimuthal form of the magnetic field of a straight wire and drives circulating currents.

AI.tldr: 该文提出，三种各向同性相的无序复合材料可以无需磁性、在具有三重或更高转轴的方向上产生轴向热电势，且"三相"在三重对称下是最低要求；作者给出了弱对比展开下的立方项表达式、可由晶网打印实现的三维结构，以及可认证的双侧界限数值。
AI.motivation: 传统上，将温度梯度在各面内方向上转化为垂直电场的"轴向热电势"依赖磁性而违反时间反演互易性。作者希望只借助互易的弹性带输运来实现，但证明在三重或更高对称轴下，纯弹性带输运以及两各向同性相、理想界面的复合材料中该效应都会消失，因此需要新的结构机制。
AI.method: 将三相视为"颜色"进行排列组合分析，识别允许轴向无磁性热电势的构型；通过弱对比展开证明最低允许项为三阶立方项，正比于三个输运矩阵的行列式乘以材料加权的手性三点关联；利用网状化学中的晶网（如木堆结构、平面单元）并借助可认证的双侧界限（certified two-sided bounds）计算其轴向 Seebeck 系数。
AI.result: 在平面单元中得到轴向 Seebeck 系数 49.5–50.2 μV K⁻¹，在可打印木堆结构中为 76–84 μV K⁻¹；并通过含该轴的平面反射可反转响应、将 24 个晶网重新着色以恢复母对称性可关闭该效应，可认证的双侧界限验证了数值。
AI.conclusion: 三各向同性相复合材料可在无磁性条件下实现轴向热电势；在三重或更高对称轴下三相为最小值。绕线热源时，轴向驱动场呈 1/r 方位角形式，类似直导线磁场，可驱动环流；该响应可通过对称反射反转、通过重着色关闭，说明其受几何与手性对称控制。

title: Charge density-supervised real-space representations for atomistic energy prediction
summary: Ground-state electron density contains sufficient information to determine ground-state energy, while providing spatial electronic information. This study developed a charge-density-informed graph neural network (hereafter CDGNN) that jointly learns energy and valence electron density from equivariant atomic graphs. This approach incorporates density-supervised real-space probe representations into the global energy regressor, allowing density-related spatial information to contribute to energy prediction. On the QM9 dataset, CDGNN reduced the energy prediction errors relative to an equivariant GNN baseline for interpolation and extrapolation to larger molecules. For small H-containing Fe and Fe-C datasets, CDGNN performed similarly to the baseline, indicating the dataset-dependent benefits of density supervision. CDGNN also accurately predicted the charge density distributions for molecular and Fe-based systems. The attention analysis showed higher weights for probe representations near the H atoms in Fe-based structures. These findings highlight the potential of integrating charge-density information for energy prediction and its task-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出电荷密度信息图神经网络CDGNN，从等变原子图同时学习能量与价电子密度，并用密度监督的实空间探针表示辅助能量预测；在QM9上提升插值/外推精度，在Fe基小数据集上与基线相当。
AI.motivation: 基态电子密度可确定基态能量且携带空间电子信息，但现有等变图神经网络能量预测未充分利用密度这一物理先验，作者希望将密度信息注入能量回归以改善精度与泛化。
AI.method: 构建电荷密度信息图神经网络CDGNN：基于等变原子图联合学习能量与价电子密度，将密度监督的实空间探针表示引入全局能量回归器，使密度相关空间信息参与能量预测；并在QM9及小型含H的Fe、Fe-C数据集上评估，辅以注意力分析。
AI.result: QM9上能量预测误差较等变GNN基线在插值与向大分子外推时降低；小规模含H的Fe与Fe-C数据集上与基线相近；CDGNN能准确预测分子及Fe基体系电荷密度；注意力分析显示Fe基结构中H原子附近探针表示权重更高。
AI.conclusion: 整合电荷密度信息可提升能量预测，但收益依赖任务与数据集，密度监督并非普遍有效；今后需针对体系特性设计密度引导策略。

title: Real-Space Selection Rule for Moiré Exciton-Phonon Coupling
summary: Exciton-phonon coupling (ExPC) governs energy relaxation and exciton dynamics in photoexcited quantum materials. Recent advances have revealed rich and tunable excitonic phenomena in moiré superlattices, yet the microscopic mechanisms underlying the coupling between moiré excitons and moiré phonons remain elusive. Here, we develop a real-space representation for moiré ExPC based on a unified theoretical framework combining the many-body Bethe-Salpeter equation with phonon perturbation theory. Furthermore, we uncover a general real-space selection rule: the spatial matching of a moiré exciton's electron and hole densities with the moiré-phonon-induced potential perturbations determines their individual coupling contributions, while coherent interference between the electron and hole contributions controls the total ExPC. We demonstrate this rule in prototypical WSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayers, revealing pronounced exciton- and phonon-mode-dependent coupling, including nearly complete suppression of ExPC through destructive electron-hole interference. These findings establish the internal electron-hole spatial configuration of moiré excitons as a key degree of freedom governing the strength and mode selectivity of their coupling to moiré phonons, opening opportunities to engineer ExPC through spatially tailored moiré potentials.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了基于BSE与声子微扰论的实空间moiré激子-声子耦合(ExPC)理论框架，揭示"实空间选择定则"：激子电子/空穴密度与moiré声子势扰动的空间匹配决定各自贡献，而电子-空穴相干干涉决定总耦合，并在WSe2/WS2中实现近完全抑制。
AI.motivation: moiré超晶格中激子现象丰富可调，但moiré激子与moiré声子耦合的微观机制尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对耦合强度与模式选择性的空间图像理解。
AI.method: 将多体Bethe-Salpeter方程与声子微扰论统一，构建moiré ExPC的实空间表示；提出并验证实空间选择定则，以原型WSe2/WS2 moiré异质双层为对象进行计算演示。
AI.result: 发现显著的激子依赖与声子模式依赖的耦合行为，包括由电子-空穴相消干涉导致的ExPC近乎完全抑制；总耦合由电子与空穴贡献的相干干涉调控，单个贡献由电子/空穴密度与moiré声子势扰动的空间匹配决定。
AI.conclusion: moiré激子的内部电子-空穴空间构型是决定其与moiré声子耦合强度与模式选择性的关键自由度，为通过空间剪裁moiré势来调控ExPC提供新途径。

title: Stripe antiferromagnetic order and spin dynamics in the Shastry-Sutherland Ising compound Er2Be2GeO7
summary: In rare-earth compounds, the interplay between geometric frustration and unusual single-ion anisotropy caused by the crystal electric field often leads to exotic magnetic phases. Here, we investigate the magnetic properties of the rare-earth Shastry-Sutherland compound Er$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$ using bulk measurements and neutron scattering down to sub-Kelvin temperatures. A $k=(0,0,0)$ stripe-like antiferromagnetic order with locally tilted Er$^{3+}$ moments is revealed by time-of-flight neutron powder diffraction, accompanied with a $λ$-shape specific-heat anomaly at $T_N=0.84$ K. The temperature dependence of the magnetic peak intensity corresponding to the ordered moment of Er$^{3+}$ approximates to the two-dimensional Ising universality class. Thermal- and cold-neutron inelastic scattering experiments demonstrate that the strong Ising anisotropy originates from the local crystal electric field, and reveal gapped magnetic excitations with weak dispersion in the ordered state. Mean-field random-phase approximation with inequivalent nearest-neighbor couplings accounts well for the collective excitations, while classical Monte Carlo simulations yield the fractional $1/4$ and $1/2$ magnetization plateaus. Our work provides a comprehensive description of the spin correlations in Er$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$ with a particular focus on the classical origin of its fractional magnetization plateaus.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀土Shastry-Sutherland化合物Er2Be2GeO7的磁性,发现k=(0,0,0)条纹状反铁磁序与强Ising各向异性,并探讨其分数磁化平台的经典起源。
AI.motivation: 稀土化合物中几何阻挫与晶体电场诱导的异常单离子各向异性之间的相互作用常导致奇异磁相,作者希望厘清Er2Be2GeO7中的磁关联及分数磁化平台的形成机制。
AI.method: 结合体物性测量与亚开尔文温度下的中子散射(飞行时间粉末衍射、热中子与冷中子非弹性散射),并用平均场RPA(考虑不等价最近邻耦合)与经典Monte Carlo模拟进行分析。
AI.result: 观察到T_N=0.84 K处λ型比热异常及k=(0,0,0)条纹状反铁磁序(Er3+磁矩局部倾斜);有序矩强度随温度变化接近二维Ising普适类;强Ising各向异性源于局域晶体电场,有序态存在弱色散的带隙磁激发;经典MC给出1/4与1/2分数磁化平台。
AI.conclusion: 本工作全面刻画了Er2Be2GeO7的 spin 关联,重点阐释其分数磁化平台的经典起源。

title: Kinetic Sectors and Nonequilibrium Dynamics in the $δ$-Ising Model
summary: We introduce and analyze the $δ$-Ising model, a kinetic Ising ferromagnet in which single-spin flips are accepted when their energy change does not exceed a tunable threshold. Varying the field and threshold opens or closes local flip channels, dividing parameter space into kinetic sectors, each governed by a fixed Markov transition operator. We prove that the dynamics retains global spin-inversion symmetry exactly when up and down spins have equal numbers of open channels. In one such sector on a periodic chain of length $L$, unbiased random initial states therefore reach the field-aligned and antifield states with probability $1/2$ each. Closing a single channel leaves both states absorbing but makes the probability of ordering against the field decay as $(2/π)^L$. Parameter sweeps correspond to ordered products of sector operators, which separate reaching a state from holding it, so hysteresis appears when a state is reached and released at different sector boundaries. We also show how increasing the system size can induce a Mpemba-like reversal, allowing a state with more misaligned spins to reach the final ordered state sooner on average. On a periodic chain, this reversal arises because the mean absorption time grows logarithmically with system size for many short domains but linearly for a single macroscopic domain, and it disappears when the bulk flip channel is opened. These findings show how a simple, intuitive rule for Ising dynamics links local kinetic constraints to field response, memory, and relaxation within a unified framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析δ-Ising模型（单自旋翻转仅在能量变化不超过可调阈值时被接受），证明其全局自旋反转对称性在上下游开放通道数相等时精确成立，并揭示动力学扇区、磁滞、以及尺寸诱导的类Mpemba反转现象。
AI.motivation: 经典Ising动力学常缺乏可调的局部动力学约束以系统区分"到达某态"与"保持某态"。作者希望用一个简单直观的规则（能量阈值控制翻转）统一刻画局部动力学约束如何影响场响应、记忆（磁滞）与弛豫行为。
AI.method: 构建δ-Ising模型：单自旋翻转的能量变化不超过阈值δ时被接受。通过变化外场与阈值，参数空间被划分为若干"动力学扇区"，每扇区由固定Markov转移算子描述。作者对周期链严格证明自旋反转对称性条件，计算非偏随机初态到达场对齐/反场态的概率，分析关闭单通道后的吸收与排序概率(2/π)^L，并将参数扫描刻画为扇区算子的有序乘积以解释磁滞；进一步比较短畴与宏观畴的平均吸收时间（对数vs线性增长），解释类Mpemba反转。
AI.result: (1) 当上下游自旋开放通道数相等时，动力学精确保留全局自旋反转对称性，此时非偏初态到达场对齐与反场态概率各为1/2；(2) 关闭一个通道后两态均为吸收态，但逆场排序概率按(2/π)^L指数衰减；(3) 磁滞源于态在不同扇区边界被到达与被释放；(4) 增大系统尺寸可诱导类Mpemba反转：多短畴时平均吸收时间随L对数增长，单宏观畴时线性增长；打开体翻转通道后该反转消失。
AI.conclusion: δ-Ising模型以单一可调阈值规则，将局部动力学约束与场响应、记忆（磁滞）和弛豫（含类Mpemba反转）纳入统一框架，展示了简单规则如何产生丰富的非平衡现象。

title: Magnetic Imaging with High Spatial Resolution Using a Single Niobium-Nitride-Based Three-Dimensional Nanobridge Junction
summary: The nanobridge junctions (NBJs) allow the miniaturization of the Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID) and improve the spatial resolution of scanning SQUID microscopy. However, the SQUID loop diameter imposed a fundamental limit on the resolution. In this work, we proposed a single niobium-nitride-based three-dimensional nanobridge junction (NbN-3D-NBJ) alternative to the nanoSQUID for high-resolution magnetic imaging. The critical current of an NbN-3D-NBJ showed an nearly monotonic dependence on the external magnetic field, enabling nanoscale mapping of the magnetic field distribution by measuring the junction's critical current with an intrinsic noise level of 100 nT/Hz^1/2. Using a NbN-3D-NBJ probe, we successfully imaged an Abrikosov vortex in a niobium film with a minimal full width at half maxima (FWHM) of 530 nm, constrained by the distance from the junction to the probe tip edge. Furthermore, we resolved 80 nm spacings between the superconducting nanowires utilizing a second probe with an optimized junction-to-tip distance. Thus, the single 3D NbN NBJ probe has been demonstrated as an effective approach for magnetic imaging with ultra-high spatial resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出NbN三维纳米桥结(NbN-3D-NBJ)替代nanoSQUID进行高分辨磁成像，其临界电流随外场近单调变化，实现空间分辨率优于SQUID的磁分布测量，可成像Abrikosov涡旋(FWHM 530 nm)并分辨80 nm间距的超导纳米线。
AI.motivation: 纳米桥结NBJ可小型化SQUID并提升扫描SQUID显微术的空间分辨率，但SQUID环路直径构成分辨率的基本极限，需要一种不依赖环路尺寸的替代方案。
AI.method: 制备单一氮化铌基三维纳米桥结(NbN-3D-NBJ)作为探针，利用其临界电流对外磁场的近单调依赖关系，通过测量临界电流实现纳米尺度磁场分布成像；并优化结到针尖边缘的距离以进一步提升分辨率。
AI.result: 本征噪声水平为100 nT/Hz^1/2；用NbN-3D-NBJ探针在铌膜中成像Abrikosov涡旋，最小半高全宽530 nm(受结到针尖边缘距离限制)；使用优化结-针尖距离的第二支探针，可分辨超导纳米线之间80 nm的间距。
AI.conclusion: 单个NbN三维纳米桥结探针被证明是实现超高空间分辨率磁成像的有效途径，突破了SQUID环路尺寸带来的分辨率限制。

title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
summary: Transition-metal-based batteries rely on critical elements such as lithium, cobalt, and nickel. Their extraction creates environmental and supply-chain challenges. Organic electrode materials (OEMs) reduce this reliance and provide broad molecular tunability. However, OEM-based batteries still show limited long-term cycling stability. Their design also requires the joint optimization of coupled metrics such as voltage, specific capacity, capacity retention, and energy density. These metrics depend on the full battery stack and on the interactions among its components rather than on the active material alone. In our previous work, we developed a data-fusion multi-task framework for average discharge voltage and first-cycle specific capacity. Both targets are single-valued. Here, we extend that framework to multi-horizon prediction by predicting a property at every cycle of a discharge trajectory rather than at a single cycle. Our multi-fidelity and Multi-horizon Deep Operator Network learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories within one model. We train it on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions, so it learns battery-stack interactions rather than cathode-only effects. This framework supports long-term property prediction, inverse design, and process optimization for organic battery systems.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了此前的数据融合多任务框架，提出多保真、多时间步的Deep Operator Network，可同时学习DFT氧化还原电位与逐循环比容量轨迹，基于完整电池堆表示进行长期性能预测、逆向设计与工艺优化。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属电池依赖锂、钴、镍等关键元素，开采带来环境与供应链问题；有机电极材料（OEMs）可降低依赖并具备分子可调性，但长期循环稳定性有限。其设计需联合优化电压、比容量、容量保持率、能量密度等耦合指标，而这些指标取决于整个电池堆及各组分相互作用，而非仅活性材料。此前工作仅预测单值指标（平均放电电压、首圈比容量），无法刻画循环衰减轨迹。
AI.method: 将原数据融合多任务框架扩展为多时间步（multi-horizon）预测：在每个放电循环而非单点循环上预测性质。提出多保真、多时间步的Deep Operator Network（DeepONet），在单一模型中同时学习DFT氧化还原电位与循环依赖的比容量轨迹；训练输入为完整电池堆表示及使用条件，从而学习电池堆层面的相互作用而非仅正极效应。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；定性上，模型可在同一框架内联合预测DFT电位与逐循环容量轨迹，并能基于完整电池堆信息进行长期性质预测，支持逆向设计与工艺优化。
AI.conclusion: 该多保真多时间步DeepONet框架为有机电池体系提供了长期性能预测、逆向设计与工艺优化能力，弥补了单值预测在循环稳定性建模上的不足。

title: Stability reversal, activated escape, and mechanical response of negative-mobility particles
summary: Understanding the fluctuations and response of particles in potential landscapes is a fundamental problem in nonequilibrium statistical physics. Here, we investigate how negative mobility reshapes the stochastic behavior of a particle moving in a mechanical potential landscape. We consider a one-dimensional overdamped particle subject to additive noise, with mobility that is negative at weak forces and positive at strong forces. In a potential well, negative mobility destabilizes the mechanical potential minimum and produces bimodal localization at two off-center positions. The same stability reversal transforms conventional Kramers escape from a potential well into a two-stage escape process involving an intermediate metastable state. When an additional spatially uniform force is applied, the mechanical perturbation translates rather than tilts the effective double well, yielding a positive response dominated at weak noise by intrawell relaxation, even though slow interwell switching dominates spontaneous positional fluctuations. These findings reveal how negative mobility reshapes the interplay among mechanical landscapes, stochastic stability, and response.

AI.tldr: 负迁移率会反转势阱中的稳定性，产生双峰局域化和两阶段逃逸，并改变对外力的响应机制。
AI.motivation: 粒子在势场中的涨落与响应是非平衡统计物理的基本问题，而负迁移率如何重塑这种随机行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 研究一维过阻尼粒子，受加性噪声，迁移率在弱力下为负、强力下为正；分析势阱中的稳定性、Kramers逃逸及均匀力下的响应。
AI.result: 负迁移率使势阱极小点失稳，粒子局域在偏离中心的两个位置（双峰）；逃逸变为含中间亚稳态的两阶段过程；均匀力下机械扰动平移而非倾斜有效双势阱，弱噪声下响应由阱内弛豫主导。
AI.conclusion: 负迁移率深刻重塑了机械势场、随机稳定性与响应之间的相互作用。

title: Spin-polarized tunneling from a Kondo insulator: equilibrium surface magnetism versus magneto-electric response in SmB$_6$
summary: We theoretically analyze the spin-polarized tunneling between SmB$_6$ tip and the bicollinear antiferromagnet Fe$_{1+x}$Te. The emergence of magnetic contrast in tunneling requires time-reversal symmetry breaking on the surface of the tip. The magnetic contrast part of the tunneling conductance then has two contributions: the first one originates from the magnetic moment due to the equilibrium long-range order on the surface, while the other is governed by the magnetic moment induced by the electric field of the junction through the surface magneto-electric effect. We show that the ratio of the equilibrium moment to the response extracted near zero bias equals, up to the sign, twice the bias at which the contrast changes sign, independently of the relative strength of the two mechanisms, so that this ratio itself does not measure the strength of the magneto-electric effect. We find that within the experimental energy window $|eV|\lesssim10$~meV the {bias-dependent} field-induced contribution is at most a few percent of the equilibrium one, and the two become comparable only at biases of order $100$~meV or higher. The ratio of the field-induced to the equilibrium contribution is inversely proportional to the distance between the tip and the substrate.

AI.tldr: 理论分析了 SmB6 针尖与双共线反铁磁体 Fe1+xTe 之间的自旋极化隧穿，指出磁对比度包含平衡表面磁矩与电场诱导（磁电效应）两部分贡献，并给出二者的比值关系与量级估计。
AI.motivation: 实验在 SmB6 针尖隧穿中观察到磁对比度，但其来源（平衡长程有序磁矩 vs. 表面磁电效应引起的场致磁矩）以及如何从数据中提取磁电效应强度并不清楚，需要理论澄清。
AI.method: 建立自旋极化隧穿理论：要求针尖表面时间反演对称性破缺；将磁对比部分电导分解为平衡表面磁矩贡献与结电场经表面磁电效应诱导的磁矩贡献，并解析推导两者比值与偏压、针尖-样品距离的关系。
AI.result: 零偏附近平衡磁矩与响应之比（至多相差符号）等于对比度变号偏压的两倍，且与两种机制相对强度无关，因此该比值本身并不能度量磁电效应强度；在 |eV| ≲ 10 meV 实验窗口内场致贡献至多占平衡贡献的百分之几，两者仅在约 100 meV 或更高偏压时可比；场致与平衡贡献之比反比于针尖-衬底间距。
AI.conclusion: SmB6/Fe1+xTe 隧穿中观测到的磁对比度主要由平衡表面磁矩主导，磁电效应贡献很小；解释实验时应避免把该比值误当作磁电耦合强度的度量。

title: ZnO/Ni interface-activated enhancement of spintronic terahertz emission from Ni/Pt bilayers
summary: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters based on ferromagnet/heavy-metal bilayers provide an efficient route for generating broadband THz radiation through ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. However, Ni/Pt bilayers usually exhibit relatively weak THz emission, limiting their use as efficient spintronic emitters. Here, we report an interface-assisted enhancement of THz emission in ZnO/Ni/Pt heterostructures. By placing ZnO underneath Ni while preserving the direct Ni/Pt contact, the THz amplitude is increased by up to approximately 2.8 times compared with the Ni/Pt reference. The enhanced emission reverses polarity with the magnetic field and follows the expected angular dependence of ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. ZnO-, Ni-, and Pt-thickness-dependent measurements show that the emission remains governed by the Ni/Pt conversion process but is strongly affected by the ZnO/Ni bottom interface. Control samples with Al2O3, Cu, and Fe further exclude a simple underlayer, optical, or growth-quality origin. The enhancement is attributed to a short-range ZnO/Ni interface effect, possibly involving oxygen-related defects, interfacial electric fields, and modification of the Ni interfacial state. This work provides a semiconductor/ferromagnet interface-engineering strategy for activating weak Ni/Pt spintronic THz emitters.

AI.tldr: 在保持Ni/Pt直接接触的前提下，于Ni下方插入ZnO，可将Ni/Pt自旋太赫兹发射幅度提升约2.8倍，该增强源于ZnO/Ni短程界面效应而非光学或生长质量因素。
AI.motivation: Ni/Pt双层虽能通过超快自旋-电荷转换产生宽带太赫兹辐射，但其发射强度较弱，限制了实际应用，亟需提升方案。
AI.method: 构建ZnO/Ni/Pt异质结，保持Ni/Pt直接接触，仅改变底层界面；通过磁场极性、角度依赖及ZnO/Ni/Pt厚度依赖测量确认机制，并用Al2O3、Cu、Fe对照样品排除单纯底层、光学效应与生长质量因素。
AI.result: 太赫兹幅度相比Ni/Pt参考样品最高提升约2.8倍；发射随磁场反转极性并符合超快自旋-电荷转换的角度依赖；发射仍由Ni/Pt转换过程主导，但受ZnO/Ni底界面强烈调制；对照样品排除其他来源。
AI.conclusion: 增强归因于ZnO/Ni短程界面效应，可能涉及氧相关缺陷、界面电场及Ni界面态改变；提出了一种半导体/铁磁界面工程策略来激活弱Ni/Pt自旋太赫兹发射器。

title: The role of A in ARPES
summary: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) was developed in the 1970s-1990s as a momentum-resolved probe of the electronic structure of solids, with its basic principles summarized in early seminal works and classic reviews. The basic ARPES result is currently almost exclusively associated with the two-dimensional intensity distribution with coordinate axes labeled as Binding Energy and Momentum. Such datasets are usually directly compared to the band structure calculations along high symmetry directions of the Brillouin zone. Here we show that this is the result of an oversimplified treatment of the ARPES data leading to incorrect interpretations of the experimental results. We suggest practical ways of how to avoid it in both data collection and analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文指出当前ARPES数据普遍以"结合能—动量"二维强度图呈现并与高对称方向能带计算直接比较，是过度简化处理，会导致错误解释，并提出在数据采集与分析中避免该问题的实用方法。
AI.motivation: ARPES常被当作动量分辨的电子结构探针，但基本结果几乎唯一地与二维强度分布（结合能 vs 动量）及高对称方向能带计算对比，这种惯例源于对数据的过度简化处理，可能产生对实验结果的误读，作者希望纠正这一做法。
AI.method: 以方法学评述的形式，回顾ARPES自1970s–1990s的发展与经典综述中的基本原理，分析"结合能—动量"二维强度图直接对比能带计算这一做法的局限，并提出在数据采集与数据分析环节的可操作规避方案。
AI.result: 论证了将ARPES结果简化为单一二维强度分布并与高对称方向能带计算直接比较会造成错误解释，说明需要更完整的数据表示与更谨慎的采集、分析流程。
AI.conclusion: ARPES数据的呈现与解释不能停留在简化的二维强度图直接对标能带计算；作者给出实用建议，以在实验采集和数据分析中避免误读，提高结果诠释的可靠性。

title: Structural supermodulation enables resonant Raman determination of crystalline orientation in Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x flakes
summary: Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x (Bi-2212) is a d-wave superconductor with unconventional properties intrinsic to the material itself. These properties are of growing interest for quantum technologies in electronics and photonics, and twisted Josephson junctions can make direct use of them. However, Bi-2212 is strongly anisotropic, and it is challenging to find its crystal axes in flakes in advance, which limits device engineering. Here, we show that polarized resonant Raman spectroscopy reveals the orientation of both the a and b axes of Bi-2212 optically and non-destructively. By correlating Laue diffraction, HAADF-STEM and polarized Raman scattering on the same bulk crystal, we assign the b axis, along which the incommensurate structural supermodulation propagates, to the intensity maximum of the 27 cm-1 supermodulation mode, which varies in counter-phase with the 118 cm-1 Bi/Sr mode, along the a axis. Multi-wavelength measurements (458, 532, 660 nm) show that resulting in-plane contrast peaks at 532 nm and nearly vanishes at 660 nm, indicating that the anisotropy originates from an electronic resonance induced by the supermodulation. Using this resonance, we determine the crystallographic axes of exfoliated flakes and access their symmetry channels, providing a rapid orientation tool for cuprate van der Waals heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文证明偏振共振拉曼光谱可光学、无损地确定Bi-2212薄片的a、b晶轴取向，为铜氧化物范德华异质结提供快速定向工具。
AI.motivation: Bi-2212是d波超导体，具有对量子电子与光子技术有吸引力的非常规性质，扭曲约瑟夫森结可直接利用这些性质。但该材料各向异性强，难以预先确定薄片的晶轴，限制了器件工程。
AI.method: 在同一块体晶体上关联Laue衍射、HAADF-STEM与偏振拉曼散射，将27 cm-1超调制模的强度极大值对应到b轴（非公度结构超调制传播方向），该模与沿a轴的118 cm-1 Bi/Sr模反相变化；并用458、532、660 nm多波长测量研究面内衬度来源。
AI.result: 面内对比度在532 nm处达到峰值、在660 nm处近乎消失，表明各向异性源于超调制诱导的电子共振。利用该共振成功确定剥离薄片的晶轴并获取其对称通道。
AI.conclusion: 偏振共振拉曼（最优532 nm）是一种快速、无损的晶轴定向方法，可用于铜氧化物范德华异质结的器件制备。

title: Spontaneous topological diode effect induced by non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order
summary: In non-centrosymmetric bulk materials, electrons flowing in the opposite directions often exhibit different properties. This diode-like effect (i.e., non-reciprocal electron transport) typically originates from relativistic spin-orbit coupling, and its amplitude scales with external magnetic field or magnetization in ferromagnets. Although such rectification is usually absent in antiferromagnets at zero field, recent theories predict that non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order can host large non-reciprocity even without spin-orbit coupling, magnetization or external magnetic fields. This phenomenon - the spontaneous topological diode effect - can potentially be used for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, while it has not been verified for real materials. Here, we report the observation of this effect in a chiral-lattice non-coplanar antiferromagnet CoTa3S6. Nonlinear resistivity measurements reveal the non reciprocal nature of electron transport along the [001] direction at zero field. The observed non-reciprocity exceeds that in typical ferromagnets, whose amplitude is governed by antiferromagnetic order parameter rather than magnetization. First-principles calculations show that the non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order induces asymmetric band dispersions even without spin-orbit coupling, establishing the non-relativistic origin of the observed response. The present findings demonstrate a new mechanism for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, and highlight non-coplanar antiferromagnets as a promising material platform for realizing ferromagnet-like functional responses without relying on spin-orbit coupling or magnetization.

AI.tldr: 本文在非共面反铁磁体CoTa3S6中首次实验观测到零场下的自发拓扑二极管效应（非互易电子输运），其非互易性超过典型铁磁体，源于反铁磁序参量而非磁化，且无需自旋轨道耦合，为反铁磁畴的电学读出提供了新机制。
AI.motivation: 非互易电子输运（二极管效应）通常源于相对论自旋轨道耦合，其幅度依赖外磁场或磁化，在零场反铁磁体中一般不存在。理论预言非共面反铁磁序可在无自旋轨道耦合、无磁化、无外场下产生大的非互易性（自发拓扑二极管效应），可用于反铁磁畴的高效电学读出，但此前尚无实际材料验证。
AI.method: 在手性晶格非共面反铁磁体CoTa3S6中，沿[001]方向于零场下进行非线性电阻率测量以探测非互易输运；并结合第一性原理计算分析能带色散。
AI.result: 零场下沿[001]方向观测到非互易电子输运，其幅度超过典型铁磁体，且受反铁磁序参量而非磁化调控；第一性原理计算表明非共面反铁磁序在无自旋轨道耦合情况下即可诱导非对称能带色散，证实该响应的非相对论起源。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了自发拓扑二极管效应在实际材料中的存在，提出反铁磁畴高效电学读出的新机制，并表明非共面反铁磁体是无需依赖自旋轨道耦合或磁化即可实现类铁磁功能响应的有前景材料平台。

title: Spin-Orbit-Torque-Driven Recurrent Motion of Synthetic Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions for Magnetic Clocking
summary: Magnetic skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets have emerged as attractive information carriers for spintronic technologies due to their compensated topology, which mitigates the skyrmion Hall effect and facilitates reliable current-driven transport. Here we present a frequency-tunable magnetic clocking concept based on the recurring translational motion of SAF skyrmions and define the material conditions needed to realize it in a Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co multilayer. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the combined effects of interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and interlayer Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida exchange coupling, delineating the parameter space in which coupled Néel-type skyrmions with opposite topological charges form a stable, topologically compensated pair. Under spin-orbit torque excitation, the SAF skyrmions exhibit resilient longitudinal transport with minimal transverse deflection using periodic boundary conditions. Periodic boundary conditions serve as an idealized model for closed-loop racetrack geometries, facilitating the study of continuous transport cycles and long-range steady-state dynamics. The oscillation frequency is readily modified by the applied current density and material characteristics, offering a pathway to field-free nanoscale timing components. Moreover, the threshold-activated initiation of recurrent transport mimics tonic-spiking behavior, indicating possible use in neuromorphic signal generation. This work establishes SAF skyrmions as versatile building elements for future spintronic functional devices by integrating topological protection, controllable transport, and cyclic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于合成反铁磁体(SAF)中拓扑补偿斯格明子往复平移运动的频率可调"磁时钟"概念，用微磁模拟厘清iDMI与层间RKKY耦合的参数空间，实现无场纳米计时与类神经脉冲生成。
AI.motivation: SAF斯格明子因拓扑补偿可抑制斯格明子霍尔效应、实现可靠电流驱动输运，是有前景的信息载体；但尚缺乏将其往复动力学转化为可调频率器件的方案与材料条件判据。
AI.method: 针对Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co多层膜，采用微磁模拟研究界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用(iDMI)与层间RKKY交换耦合的协同效应，划定形成稳定、拓扑补偿的相反拓扑荷耦合Néel型斯格明子对的参数空间；在自旋轨道矩激励下、采用周期性边界条件（近似闭合赛道）模拟纵向输运与长程稳态循环。
AI.result: 耦合SAF斯格明子对在SOT驱动下表现出稳健的纵向输运，横向偏转极小；振荡频率可由电流密度与材料参数调节；往复运动呈阈值触发的" tonic-spiking"式启动行为。
